look_here_first: Start with the flower color and inflorescence. Ruellia metziae has conspicuously large white flowers in a terminal panicle of opposite cymes, and the upper inflorescence axes and calyx are densely stalked-glandular-hairy.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: upper inflorescence with dense stalked glandular hairs

lookalikes.differences: R. ciliatiflora usually has violet to purple flowers and less strikingly white corollas. R. metziae is easiest to recognize by the large white flowers plus glandular-hairy upper inflorescence.
